source_caption:
𝐃𝐚𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐅𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭, 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟑.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
I had been waiting months to see 𝐃𝐚𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐅𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭, the debut feature from Jack Huston, grandson of legendary director John Huston. Its long absence from theaters made me fear the worst. Hollywood history is full of mediocre films by the children and grandchildren of famous artists, often buoyed by impressive casts more out of loyalty than confidence.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Those concerns faded once I got the chance to watch 𝐃𝐚𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐅𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭. Jack Huston, best known as an actor in Boardwalk Empire and Fargo, proves himself to be a very talented filmmaker with a distinctive visual style. The film follows Mike (Michael Pitt), a former middleweight champion who is attempting an unlikely comeback after a tragic accident destroyed his career and led to a prison sentence. On the day of his title fight, Mike reconnects with friends, former loves, and people who shaped his life, creating a moving portrait of regret, redemption, and second chances.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
The film’s black-and-white cinematography is particularly striking. Every frame is carefully composed, giving the movie a timeless quality. Huston and cinematographer Peter Simonite create memorable images that elevate even simple conversations. The boxing sequences are equally impressive, providing a tense and exciting climax that feels both believable and emotionally satisfying.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Michael Pitt delivers a restrained and convincing performance as the troubled boxer. And, as of now, this remains Joe Pesci's most recent acting performance. Although the film occasionally reveals Huston’s inexperience as a first-time director, its strengths far outweigh its weaknesses. An impressive debut and a surprisingly moving film. Most importantly, it demonstrates that Jack Huston possesses genuine talent and a promising future behind the camera.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Rate 𝐃𝐚𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐅𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 (𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟑) out of ten.

source_details.title: Day of the Fight
source_details.synopsis: Day of the Fight is a 2023 American drama film written and directed by Jack Huston in his directorial debut. It was inspired by and named after Day of the Fight, Stanley Kubrick's 1951 short-subject documentary. It stars Michael Pitt, Nicolette Robinson, John Magaro, Steve Buscemi, Ron Perlman, and Joe Pesci. It premiered at the 80th Venice International Film Festival on September 5, 2023.
